title: Minestrone
subtitle: Italian vegetable and pasta soup
excerpt: A thick, hearty Italian soup packed with seasonal vegetables, cannellini beans, and small pasta shapes. It is designed to use whatever is on hand and rewards long, slow simmering that coaxes deep flavour from humble ingredients.
sourceNotes: Minestrone, from the Italian word for 'big soup', has been a staple of the Italian peasant table for centuries. The recipe changes by region and by season, but the principle of slow-cooked vegetables in a tomato broth remains constant.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze without the pasta. Add freshly cooked pasta when reheating.
recipe.batchNotes: Scales well. Make a large batch and portion for lunches.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Tastes better the next day once the flavours have had time to develop.

content.text: The soffritto base of onion, carrot, and celery cooked slowly in olive oil is the foundation of the soup's flavour. Do not rush it. Add the pasta only in the last 10 minutes so it does not absorb all the liquid and turn starchy.

items.prepNote: small shapes such as ditalini or small shells

content.text: Warm the olive oil in the stockpot over a low-medium heat. Add the onion, carrot, and celery with a pinch of salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 12 to 15 minutes until soft and just starting to colour.
Add the garlic and tomato puree and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the courgette, tinned tomatoes, stock, thyme, and bay leaves. Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes.
Add the cannellini beans and pasta. Simmer for 10 minutes until the pasta is cooked through.
Stir in the kale and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until wilted. Remove the bay leaves.
Taste and season with salt and pepper. Ladle into bowls and top with grated parmesan and a drizzle of good olive oil.

items.cause: Pasta absorbed much of the liquid during cooking or sitting.
items.fix: Add a splash of hot stock to loosen before serving.

items.cause: The soup simmered too long after the vegetables were added.
items.fix: Add delicate veg like courgette in the last 15 minutes only.

items.cause: The soffritto base was not cooked long enough at the start.
items.fix: Cook onion, carrot, celery low and slow for at least 12 minutes.
